page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top centre with page number at top right; catchword/signature line at foot right ("Accu-" is a line-end hyphenated word, not a catchword to split). No margin notes.

main_text.p: vit. qui vt scopum vitæ suum reddidit, ita ipsam saluberrimis præceptis illustrauit. neque vanis, vt Apollo Delphis, ac ambiguis, sed certis ac perspicuis oraculis instruxit.

DEVM IMMORTALEM NOSSE OMNIA. FALLI HVNC AB HOMINE NON POSSE. HONESTATEM AB VTILITATE SEPARANDAM NON ESSE. BONVM VNICVM SCIENTIAM, MALVM VNICVM ESSE IGNORANTIAM. LIBERTATEM SITAM ESSE IN ANIMO. EVM EXTINGVI NON POSSE. SAPIENTI QVIDVIS ESSE SATIS, DESIPIENTI NIHIL. NVLLA RE EGERE, DEI; PAVCIS, DIVINI VIRI ESSE. quæ & publice & priuatim, & in foro non minus quam in Academia canebat. quam suauissimam illius muficam, non hyems, non autumnus, non tempestas vlla, sed plebeius furor & cicuta abrupit. Hanc in vinculis, in ferro, in lictorum manu, vt cicadæ, si in ipso cantu capiantur, sine vlla vultus commutatione aut querela, vsque ad exitum perduxit. cujus rei sine maximo dolore recordari hic non possum. Vir innocentissimus probissimusque, aduersus nemini aut grauis, morum ac viuendi publicus magister, in Rep. ac vita inculpatus, domi ac militiæ inuictus, ad quem juuentutem gratis emendandam tota vrbs mittebat, paucis displicere incipit.

page.notes: Catchword "Accu-" at foot right is a line-end word (Accusationem) rather than a true catchword; transcribed as running text beginning the next page. Faint marks and stains ignored. Printed signature "Q. f" appears at foot as a gathering mark, transcribed as a note. Some letters in the scan are blurred (e.g. "Delphis", "suauissimam") and may be misread.
